_about: Public-domain Robert Hugh Benson (1871-1914, Anglican priest turned Catholic monsignor) for the Word Hoard: his religious non-fiction only, Paradoxes of Catholicism (1913) and Lourdes (1914) from Project Gutenberg, and The Religion of the Plain Man (1906), Non-Catholic Denominations (1910), Christ in the Church (1911), The Friendship of Christ (1912), Confessions of a Convert (1913) and the Spiritual Letters (1915) from Internet Archive scans. Written in English. His novels belong to the fiction lanes. Added 2026-10-17 by lane A, round 27 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
